title: Season 3
overview: Missing for months, Matt Murdock reemerges a broken man, putting into question his future as both vigilante Daredevil and lawyer Matthew Murdock. But when his archenemy Wilson Fisk is released from prison, Matt must choose between hiding from the world or embracing his destiny as a hero.

episodes.title: Resurrection
episodes.overview: Miraculously surviving the Midland Circle implosion, a deafened and despairing Matt Murdock recovers under the care of Sister Maggie.

episodes.title: Please
episodes.overview: Matt tests his returning senses by intervening in a kidnapping, while Wilson Fisk negotiates a federal cooperating witness deal.

episodes.title: No Good Deed
episodes.overview: Fisk is moved to luxury house arrest under the supervision of troubled FBI marksman Special Agent Benjamin Poindexter.

episodes.title: Blindsided
episodes.overview: In an unbroken ten-minute sequence, Matt infiltrates a maximum security prison to question the Albanian mob, escaping a violent riot.

episodes.title: The Perfect Game
episodes.overview: Fisk learns about Agent Poindexter's psychiatric history and begins grooming him to become his personal executioner.

episodes.title: The Devil You Know
episodes.overview: Poindexter dresses in a stolen Daredevil suit and massacres journalists at the New York Bulletin, framing the real vigilante.

episodes.title: Aftermath
episodes.overview: The public turns against Daredevil as Karen Page investigates Poindexter's childhood and Matt seeks Melvin Potter.

episodes.title: Upstairs/Downstairs
episodes.overview: Matt and Ray Nadeem team up to uncover Fisk's federal corruption, while Karen visits Fisk in a dangerous battle of wits.

episodes.title: Revelations
episodes.overview: Matt learns Sister Maggie is his biological mother, while Fisk takes absolute control of the FBI field office.

episodes.title: Karen
episodes.overview: In rural Vermont and the Clinton Church, Karen Page's tragic past is revealed as Poindexter attacks the sanctuary and Father Lantom dies protecting her.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.overview: Matt, Foggy, and Karen reunite in hiding, using Agent Nadeem's dying deposition to legally corner Kingpin.

episodes.title: One Last Shot
episodes.overview: Fisk marries Vanessa in a lavish presidential ballroom while Nadeem's video testimony leaks publicly across social media.

episodes.title: A New Napkin
episodes.overview: A brutal three-way brawl erupts between Daredevil, Kingpin, and Bullseye, ending with Fisk returning to prison and Nelson, Murdock & Page reuniting.

verification.notes: Confirmed Season 3 of Daredevil. 13 episodes released simultaneously on Netflix on October 19, 2018.
